references.text: Describes the oil for the lamps and that they shall burn continuously in the tabernacle, linked to the function of the menorah.
Describes the making of the seven lamps for the menorah, as fulfillment of the instruction in Exodus 25:37.
Gives instructions to keep the lamps burning continually before the Lord in the tabernacle.
Describes how the lamps shall shine forward from the menorah, the same concept as 'light toward the front'.
Zechariah's vision of a golden menorah with seven lamps, reflecting the tabernacle's menorah.
John sees seven golden lampstands in his vision, symbolically linking back to the tabernacle's menorah.
Seven torches burn before the throne, identified as God's seven spirits, mirroring the seven lamps.
This verse confirms and repeats the specific instruction about the direction of light from Exodus 25:37, now directed straight at Aaron's execution.
The verse shows the actual fulfillment of the instruction to set up the menorah and kindle the lamps as given in Exodus 25:37.
The verse establishes the overarching principle of following God's pattern that underlies the specific instruction in Exodus 25:37.
The verse describes the very construction of the menorah as the prerequisite for being able to set up the lamps as described in Exodus 25:37.
